title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2611.28465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. translated_title: HiPPO 函数记忆：面向不规则时间序列的坐标可查询注意力机制
translated_abstract: 不规则时间序列以不均匀的时间间隔记录，并且经常需要在其他时间点上进行查询：例如在观测之间、在最后一次观测之后，或在规则网格上。连续时间模型通过积分潜在动力学来回答此类查询，而时间感知注意力模型则通过回访观测 token 来回答。我们提出了 HiPPO 函数记忆（HiPPO-FM），这是一种注意力算子，它将不规则的历史记录写入一个具有显式时间坐标的秩-M 函数空间中。掩码自注意力首先在观测之间交换内容；随后将更新后的值与经过核平滑的 HiPPO-Legendre 特征进行收缩，并通过正则化 Gram 矩阵求解，因此所保留的系数定义了一个可通过相同特征在任意时间读取的函数。写入和读取过程具有域间稀疏高斯过程均值的形式：每次读取结果都位于一个 M 维再生核子空间中，并且逐点……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 HiPPO 函数记忆（HiPPO-FM）注意力算子，将不规则时间序列的历史信息写入具有显式时间坐标的函数空间，从而可在任意时间点查询该历史。
en_tdlr: HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM) is an attention operator that writes irregular time-series history into a function space with explicit time coordinates, enabling queryable memory readouts at any point in time.
